scripts.start: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run start:server
scripts.start:full: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run start:server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
